additions.name: NTT Jakarta 2 (JKT2), original building
additions.site_identity_review: NTT names JKT2 and the connected JKT2A as separate buildings on its central Jakarta campus. The inherited Nexcenter point and the BSI property record identify the campus in Kuningan Barat.

status.summary: On November 3 NTT described the original JKT2 as an active interconnection hub hosting more than 240 network providers. This date is the operator’s observation.

locator.identity_review: NTT names JKT2 and the connected JKT2A as separate buildings on its central Jakarta campus. The inherited Nexcenter point and the BSI property record identify the campus in Kuningan Barat.

additions.distinctness_review: The operator’s brochure identifies the eight-storey original building. NTT’s November announcement describes the newly opened annex as a separate facility connected to JKT2.
additions.successor_review: NTT describes active service at the original building when the annex opened. The separately recorded Jakarta 3 campus is in Bekasi.

additions.name: Redbank Data Centre — proposed five-building campus

status.summary: In its November 10 scoping report, TAS 1 Holdings proposed a five-building data centre campus at Rowan, near Wagga Wagga. The applicant gives approximately 600 MW of planned IT load and a gross demand ceiling of 900 MW for the full campus.

locator.method: Area centroid of the union of the fourteen southern Redbank campus lots in GDA2020 / MGA zone 55 (EPSG:7855), transformed to WGS 84.
locator.precision: Generalized point within the southern project landholdings identified for the main data centre campus.
locator.identity_review: The cadastral lot identifiers match Table 2 and Figure 2 of the scoping report. Section 4.2.1 places the principal campus on the southern landholdings. The selection excludes the two northern lots and all separately listed easements.
locator.uncertainty_reason: The representative point has no surveyed horizontal uncertainty and does not identify an individual proposed building.

additions.distinctness_review: IREN’s Redbank proposal (SSD-155572991) has different southern landholdings from CDC’s Ashfords Road proposal (SSD-144289240, Lot 2 DP1143881). The prior CDC Gregadoo campus point is 2.3 km away.
additions.successor_review: The state register remained at preparation of environmental assessment requirements and the City Council listed the five-building project as proposed in its November 17 update. Neither record identified a grant of development consent or a construction start.

additions.name: VITRO Makati 2 — existing commercial colocation operations

status.summary: Hurricane Electric lists October 8, 2026 as the date its service went live at PLDT VITRO Makati 2.

locator.method: Native Overture Maps commercial place point
locator.precision: Generalized locator for the named facility’s property at 222 Nicanor Garcia Street, Barangay Bel-Air, Makati.
locator.identity_review: The customer’s own directory and the historic EPI certificate independently identify VITRO Makati 2 at civic number 222. Both the name and civic number agree with this Overture feature.
locator.uncertainty_reason: The Overture place source supplies no surveyed horizontal accuracy for this property.

additions.distinctness_review: Makati 2 at 222 Nicanor Garcia Street is distinct from Equinix MN3 Makati at 5600 South Superhighway and from VITRO Santa Rosa and Cebu. The nearest prior site, Equinix MN3 Makati, 5600 South Superhighway, is 1.9 km away.
additions.successor_review: The customer lists PLDT VITRO Makati 2 and STT Makati as separate facilities. Other reviewed property-specific offer and operator pages supply no later dated change to the physical status at Makati 2.

additions.site_name: Coravel Hicks Field campus, Fort Worth
additions.name: Coravel Hicks Field campus — construction

status.summary: On November 10, Fort Worth’s Data Center & Infrastructure Commission listed the ACS Digital/Coravel campus at Hicks Field as under construction.

locator.method: Use the regulator’s registered-site coordinates, checked against the Tarrant Appraisal District parcel.
locator.precision: Approximate campus reference point on the registered tract at 10059 Hicks Field Road.
locator.uncertainty_reason: The site registration provides no surveyed accuracy for its campus reference point.
locator.identity_review: The city names this address for the multi-tract development. The registered point falls within Tarrant account 04599799, which has that address and is recorded to ACS DC Hicks Field Road LLC.

additions.distinctness_review: The municipal inventory distinguishes Hicks Field from the other Fort Worth campuses. The city and regulator identify the Hicks Field property with the same civic address.
additions.successor_review: The November commission reports construction at campus scale. The developer describes phased delivery and the report gives no separate completion date for a building.

status.summary: Hurricane Electric confirms current commercial service at iXAfrica’s Nairobi NBOX1 campus on November 25.

status_updates.identity_review: The provider names iXAfrica NBOX1 in its release and register. The operator’s PTC presentation identifies NBOX1 and distinguishes its first building from the full Nairobi One campus and the separate Tilisi property.
status_updates.successor_review: The November 25 announcement confirms ongoing use after the operator’s October 21 observation. The provider dates its own service to September 2.
